newsitem.title: MEXICO: Japan firms to make auto parts in Mexico - report.
newsitem.headline: Japan firms to make auto parts in Mexico - report.

text.p: The Japanese company Calsonic plans to build a $46 million auto parts factory in the north-central Mexican city of Aguascalientes, the Mexican state news agency Notimex reported Sunday.
The same report said the Japanese firm Tachi would invest $6 million two build a new auto parts plant in Aguascalientes.
Citing Governor Otto Granados of Aguascalientes state, Notimex said Calsonic would install its plant over the next six months and produce car air conditioners, generating 650 jobs.
There were no additional details of the Tachi project.
